{{recipesummary|category=Cheesecake recipes|time=Slightly over 5 hours|difficulty=3}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:North American cuisines|North American Cuisines]] | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Canada|Canadian Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Desserts| Desserts]]
__NOTOC__
'''Vancouver cheesecake''' is a light, baked [[Cookbook:cheesecake|cheesecake]] variant that uses no crust. It is typically served chilled with fresh berries and a warmed sauce.

== Ingredients ==

=== Cake ===

* 500 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] [[Cookbook:Cream Cheese|cream cheese]], softened to room temperature
* 125 ml [[Cookbook:Ricotta|ricotta cheese]]
* 6 large eggs
* 250 ml [[Cookbook:Cream|whipping cream]]
* 80 ml [[Cookbook:White Sugar|white sugar]]
* 5 ml [[Cookbook:Lemon Juice|lemon juice]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Vanilla Bean|vanilla bean]], or 10 ml pure vanilla extract

=== Sauce ===

* 250 ml fresh, cleaned [[Cookbook:raspberry|raspberries]]
* 125 ml water
* 60 ml [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]]
* 30 ml [[Cookbook:Rum|rum]]

=== Garnish ===

* Raspberries

== Procedure ==

=== Cake ===

# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 160°C.
# [[Cookbook:beat|Beat]] the cream cheese and ricotta together until smooth, continue beating as you mix in the sugar, then the eggs.
# Slowly beat in the whipping cream.
# Add lemon juice.
# To add the bean, using a sharp knife, slice down the length of the bean, peel open and scrape down the bean to collect the contents. Using a spatula or second knife, scrape the contents of the bean into the mixture. [[Cookbook:fold|Fold]] in.
# Pour into large [[Cookbook:Baking Pan|baking pan]], or series of [[Cookbook:Loaf Pan|loaf pans]].
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] at 150°C for 45 minutes or so, slightly less time in loaf pans. The cake should still be jelly-like in the centre when done. Remove and allow to cool, then refrigerate for a minimum of 4 hours.

=== Sauce ===

# [[Cookbook:puree|Purée]] raspberries and strain through [[Cookbook:Cheesecloth|cheese cloth]] into a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]].
# Place berry mix on burner at medium, add water. Stir occasionally.
# When warm, stir in sugar and your rum of choice, and turn burner to high. Increase stirring rate.
# After sauce has reached a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]], turn down to a low-medium range and allow to [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] for 15 minutes, stirring constantly. Then remove from burner and allow to cool.

=== Serving ===

# Slice the cheesecake.
# Sprinkle with berries and drizzle on sauce.
# Serve.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Store sauce in an air-tight container in the fridge. Can last for up to 2 weeks, heat before serving.
* If not planning to serve in 3 days, store cake in a freezer, in an air-tight container which will not pop open. Cake should last 2 weeks if properly stored.
* To ensure quality cheesecake, be certain the ricotta and cream cheese mix is absolutely smooth prior to continuing on to the next step.
* Of course, the cake can be served without berries, or sauce, but can also be served with berries other than the raspberries used in the recipe as well as an alternative sauce.
* This cheesecake can also be served on a crust, as with more traditional recipes; this is, however, contrary to the Vancouver-style of cheesecake.
